$comment: The illustrations that passed the quality checklist, and only those. Fourteen subjects were dropped rather than regenerated: Flux returns technical illustration for cranes, rollers and excavators whatever the prompt says, and Recraft answered the style block instead of the subject line and returned generic preschool clipart. The book was reshaped around the art that works. Level 5 and several level 4 objects are drawn by scripts/pieces.py and are not here at all. The style block lives in style.txt and is prepended at generate time.

images.subject: two chunky toy traffic cones standing apart, with one smooth plain ribbon of tape stretched between them, on one simple straight ground line.
a small wall of twelve large chunky bricks in three rows, front view, each brick one smooth empty rectangle, on one simple straight ground line.

a chunky toy dump truck, side view, on the left, with a smooth rounded mound of sand in its tipper, and a smooth rounded pile of sand on the right, standing on one simple straight ground line. The wheels are plain circles with a smaller circle inside and no tread.

a chunky toy cement mixer truck, side view, with a big round drum marked by three simple diagonal stripes. Its wheels are plain circles with a smaller circle inside and no tread. It stands on one simple straight ground line.
a chunky toy road roller, side view, with one huge smooth round drum at the front and one plain round wheel at the back, on one simple straight ground line.

a chunky toy tow truck, side view, with a simple hook arm, towing one small rounded toy car. Every wheel is a plain circle with a smaller circle inside and no tread. They stand on one simple straight ground line.
a chunky toy forklift, side view, lifting a stack of three plain square boxes on its forks, on one simple straight ground line.
a chunky toy dump truck, side view, driving over two smooth rounded hills drawn as one simple curved line.
three chunky toy traffic cones standing in a row with wide space between them, front view, on one simple straight ground line.
a single traffic cone with two stripes, front view.
a single construction hard hat, side view, with nobody wearing it.
a single diamond-shaped road sign on one plain straight post, with a simple picture of a small digger on the sign and no words, on one simple straight ground line.
